baseline.procedure: Ephemeral valid-looking LF-003 production envelope with successful attempts, generated artifacts, generic PASS observations, a PASS transition, a complete continuity scorecard and editorially accepted assembly
baseline.observed_output: validate_long_form_case returned PASS with production_evidence_complete=true even though the observations had category checks but no semantic_dimension records
baseline.risk: A long-form production PASS could be asserted without the twelve-dimensional semantic artifact gate.

change.implementation: Long-form direct observations and both sides of every transition now call validate_semantic_observation instead of the category-only validate_observation_contract; the regression retains a valid semantic case and rejects the generic case.

limitations: This closes a software acceptance boundary only; it does not create or accept real LF-001, LF-002 or LF-003 generated media.
The R13 independent critic reviewed the pre-fix candidate and is invalidated for current acceptance by this material change; a fresh review is required.
